TMAN: Abbreviation of treasury man: An agent of the treasury department.
TMC: Initialism of torpedoman's mate second class.
TMESIS: The insertion of one or more words between the components of a compound word.
TMINUS: Specifies the remaining time until some future event such as a takeoff or encounter commences.
TMNT: Initialism of Teenage Mutant Ninja Turtles.
